Runs classification inference using the specified model. The request follows the PredictionService.Classify gRPC API semantics. Returns classification labels and scores.
Runs classification inference using a specific version of the model.
Runs regression inference using the specified model. The request follows the PredictionService.Regress gRPC API semantics. Returns regression values for each input example.

Runs prediction inference using the specified model. Supports both row format (instances array) and column format (inputs object). Returns predictions in the corresponding format.
Runs prediction inference using a specific version of the model.

A flexible, high-performance serving system for machine learning models designed for production environments. TensorFlow ModelServer supports REST APIs for model status checks, metadata retrieval, classification, regression, and prediction inference. All requests and responses use JSON format.
